EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Evaluation of pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
None available.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
There is a 12 mm ground-glass nodule in the posterior left upper lobe without a measurable solid component. Separate 7 mm solid nodule in the posterior right lower lobe. No focal airspace opacity.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Aortopulmonary window lymph node measures 9 mm in short axis.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
No acute abnormality in the visualized upper abdomen.

IMPRESSION:

1. 12 mm left upper lobe ground-glass nodule without solid component.
2. Separate 7 mm posterior right lower lobe solid pulmonary nodule.
3. Mildly prominent 9 mm aortopulmonary window lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Pulmonary nodule follow-up.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 04/22/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Subsolid nodule in the posterior left upper lobe measures 13 mm overall and contains a 3 mm solid component. New patchy 6 mm ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe, likely infectious or inflammatory. No other new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Aortopulmonary window node measures 10 mm in short axis, previously 9 mm.

IMPRESSION:

1. Left upper lobe subsolid nodule now measures 13 mm with a 3 mm solid component.
2. New small right upper lobe ground-glass opacity, likely inflammatory.
3. Minimally increased 10 mm aortopulmonary window lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up of subsolid pulmonary nodule.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 10/28/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Part-solid posterior left upper lobe nodule measures 12 mm overall with a 3 mm solid component, not significantly changed. The previously seen right upper lobe ground-glass opacity has resolved. Solid nodule at the posterior right lung base measures 7 mm and is unchanged. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 12 mm part-solid left upper lobe nodule with 3 mm solid component.
2. Resolved right upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
3. Stable 7 mm posterior right lower lobe nodule.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Continued surveillance of subsolid pulmonary nodule.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 05/06/2025.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Ground-glass lesion in the posterior left upper lobe measures 13 mm overall with a 4 mm internal solid focus. No recurrent right upper lobe ground-glass opacity. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
AP window lymph node measures 10 mm in short axis, unchanged.

IMPRESSION:

1. Slight increase in the solid component of the posterior left upper lobe subsolid nodule, now 4 mm.
2. Stable 10 mm AP window lymph node.
3. No recurrence of the previously resolved right upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
